root_cause: Frame timestamps reached tickers, frame callbacks and the retained animation clock raw; only a per-tree retained-animation scale existed, so standalone Tickers and scheduler stamps could not be slowed.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/scheduler.rs: thread-scheduler time_dilation()/set_time_dilation(f64) with Flutter's epoch (_adjustForEpoch, resetEpoch with the old dilation, lost interval at a change); begin_frame/end_frame pass the dilated stamp to callbacks and tickers; doc-hidden frame_timestamp(raw). crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs animation_now: the retained clock advances by dilated frame intervals (times the existing per-tree scale). crates/incular-animation/src/lib.rs: re-export (out of list, additive). Diagnostic twin harness/incular/tests/frames/anim_core.rs now uses set_time_dilation(2.0)/(1.0) instead of the 0.5 retained scale.
harness: anim_core__scheduler_callbacks_time_dilation: match (the twin uses the new API)
api_change: Additive: incular_animation::{set_time_dilation, time_dilation} (and scheduler::frame_timestamp, doc-hidden). Identity until first set, so existing behavior is unchanged.
limitations: Per UI thread, like the scheduler; gesture deadlines and pointer timestamps stay in real time. Not re-exported from the incular facade prelude (crates/incular/src/lib.rs not owned).
note: Confirmed by source review; the scenario was a diagnostic twin.

root_cause: A with_vsync controller ticks from the scheduler, outside the retained AnimationTicker visit that applies TickerMode, so an ancestor TickerMode(false) could not mute it.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: the AnimationTicker visits in tick_animations (before the build) and update_compositor (after the build) call set_ticker_muted(muted) on vsync controllers from the enclosing TickerMode or hidden Visibility, so the next frame's scheduler tick already respects a mode change.
harness: no scenario (anim_core__ 7/7 still match); the audit's requested TickerMode-toggle twin is not added (shared harness files)
api_change: Behavior: a with_vsync controller ticked through Widget::animation_ticker is muted by its TickerMode; manual set_ticker_muted on such a controller is overridden each frame.
limitations: A vsync controller not ticked through any AnimationTicker node still needs set_ticker_muted; a node removed while muted leaves its controller muted.
